data.name: Alleged SEC Securities
data.title: Alleged SEC Securities
data.description: The Alleged SEC Securities category tracks tokens that have been named by the US Securities and Exchange Commission in enforcement actions or public statements as potentially unregistered securities.

data.name: Made in America
data.title: Made in America
data.description: The Made in America category includes tokens and blockchain projects founded or primarily developed by American teams, aligning with narratives around US-based crypto innovation and domestic digital asset development.

data.name: Layer 1
data.title: Layer 1
data.description: The Layer 1 category includes base-layer blockchain networks that process and finalize transactions independently, forming the foundational settlement layer on which Layer 2 solutions and dApps are built.

data.name: FTX Bankruptcy Estate
data.title: FTX Bankruptcy Estate
data.description: The FTX Bankruptcy Estate category includes tokens that are part of the asset holdings being managed through FTX's bankruptcy proceedings following the exchange's collapse in November 2022.

data.name: US Strategic Crypto Reserve
data.title: US Strategic Crypto Reserve
data.description: The US Strategic Crypto Reserve category includes tokens designated as part of the United States government's strategic cryptocurrency reserve, a policy initiative to hold digital assets at the national level.

data.name: SEC/CFTC Digital Commodities
data.title: SEC/CFTC Digital Commodities
data.description: Cryptoassets that are intrinsically linked to and derive their value from the programmatic operation of a functional crypto system, as well as supply and demand dynamics, rather than from the expectation of profits from the essential managerial efforts of others. The SEC has classified these assets as not constituting securities under federal securities laws. This category tracks cryptoassets where value is driven by network utility and market forces rather than investment contract characteristics.

data.name: SEC/CFTC Token Taxonomy
data.title: SEC/CFTC Token Taxonomy
data.description: Cryptoassets that have been formally classified under the joint SEC-CFTC interpretive guidance framework, which established a unified taxonomy for digital assets under federal securities and commodities laws. This category encompasses assets evaluated across five regulatory sub-classifications: Digital Commodities, Digital Collectibles, Digital Tools, GENIUS Act Stablecoins, and Digital Securities (tokenized securities). Each asset's classification is determined by the regulators' analysis of its characteristics, uses, and functions against the definition of ""security"" under federal law. This category serves as a reference index for API consumers tracking the regulatory status of cryptoassets under the harmonized SEC-CFTC framework.

data.name: SEC/CFTC Token
data.title: SEC/CFTC Token
data.description:
The SEC and CFTC released a joint 5-category token taxonomy that formally clarifies digital asset jurisdiction. It defines digital commodities, digital collectibles, digital tools, and stablecoins as non-securities. Digital securities (tokenized stocks/bonds) remain under SEC jurisdiction, while the CFTC oversees digital commodities.

You can review the full interpretive guidance released by the SEC on their official SEC Clarifies Application of Federal Securities Laws to Crypto Assets page: https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026-30-sec-clarifies-application-federal-securities-laws-crypto-assets

data.name: CMC Crypto Awards 2024
data.title: CMC Crypto Awards 2024

data.name: OKX Ventures Portfolio
data.title: OKX Ventures Portfolio
data.description: The OKX Ventures Portfolio category tracks tokens that have received investment from OKX Ventures, the investment arm of OKX exchange, focused on backing promising blockchain projects across multiple verticals.

data.name: Kenetic Capital Portfolio
data.title: Kenetic Capital Portfolio
data.description: The Kenetic Capital Portfolio category tracks tokens backed by Kenetic Capital, a Hong Kong-based blockchain investment firm focused on venture and liquid token investments across Asia and globally.

data.name: CMS Holdings Portfolio
data.title: CMS Holdings Portfolio
data.description: The CMS Holdings Portfolio category tracks tokens backed by CMS Holdings, a crypto-native trading and investment firm known for its active presence in DeFi, NFTs, and early-stage token investments.

data.name: Multicoin Capital Portfolio
data.title: Multicoin Capital Portfolio
data.description: The Multicoin Capital Portfolio category tracks tokens backed by Multicoin Capital, a thesis-driven crypto investment firm known for early bets on Solana, Helium, and other high-conviction blockchain infrastructure plays.

data.name: Alameda Research Portfolio
data.title: Alameda Research Portfolio
data.description: The Alameda Research Portfolio category tracks tokens that received investment from Alameda Research, the trading firm founded by Sam Bankman-Fried that was closely associated with the FTX exchange before its collapse.

data.name: Binance Ecosystem
data.title: Binance Ecosystem
data.description: The Binance Ecosystem category broadly covers all tokens and projects within the Binance universe, including BNB Chain projects, Binance-listed assets, and ventures backed or operated by the Binance organization.

data.name: Rehypothecated Crypto
data.title: Rehypothecated Crypto
data.description: The Rehypothecated Crypto category includes tokens that are derived from re-using collateral assets already pledged in DeFi protocols, enabling additional liquidity layers on top of existing locked assets.

data.name: BNB Chain Ecosystem
data.title: Top BNB Chain Tokens by Market Capitalization
data.description: The BNB Chain Ecosystem category includes tokens and dApps built on BNB Chain (formerly Binance Smart Chain), Binance's EVM-compatible blockchain offering fast transactions and a broad DeFi ecosystem.

data.name: Polygon Ecosystem
data.title: Polygon Ecosystem
data.description: The Polygon Ecosystem category covers tokens and protocols built on Polygon's suite of scaling solutions, including its PoS chain, zkEVM, and CDK-based networks, extending Ethereum's reach with lower fees.

data.name: DeFi
data.title: Top DeFi Tokens by Market Capitalization
data.description: The DeFi (Decentralized Finance) category broadly covers protocols enabling financial services such as lending, borrowing, trading, and yield generation without centralized intermediaries, primarily on smart contract blockchains.

data.name: Near Protocol Ecosystem
data.title: Near Protocol Ecosystem
data.description: The Near Protocol Ecosystem category covers tokens and dApps on Near Protocol, a sharded Layer 1 blockchain designed for usability and scalability, featuring a developer-friendly environment and low fees.

data.name: Avalanche Ecosystem
data.title: Avalanche Ecosystem
data.description: The Avalanche Ecosystem category includes tokens and dApps built on Avalanche, a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain featuring a unique multi-chain architecture and sub-second transaction finality.

data.name: Terra Ecosystem
data.title: Terra Ecosystem
data.description: The Terra Ecosystem category includes tokens associated with the Terra blockchain and its successor networks, originally known for its algorithmic stablecoin UST before the May 2022 collapse and subsequent relaunch.

data.name: Ethereum Ecosystem
data.title: Ethereum Ecosystem
data.description: The Ethereum Ecosystem category covers the broad range of tokens and protocols built on Ethereum, the world's leading smart contract platform and the foundation of most DeFi, NFT, and Web3 activity.

data.name: Monad Ecosystem
data.title: Monad Ecosystem
data.description: The Monad Ecosystem category tracks tokens associated with Monad, a high-performance EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain designed for parallel execution and significantly higher transaction throughput than standard Ethereum.

data.name: Osmosis Ecosystem
data.title: Osmosis Ecosystem
data.description: The Osmosis Ecosystem category covers tokens within the Osmosis DEX ecosystem, the leading automated market maker and liquidity hub within the Cosmos IBC network.

data.name: Memes
data.title: Memes
data.description: The Memes category encompasses tokens created around internet culture, jokes, or viral trends, typically with no formal utility but driven largely by community enthusiasm and speculative trading.
